long_biography.plain_text:
Silvia de’ Longhi studied political science at the University of Trieste after completing the International Baccalaureate at Sevenoaks College. She began within the family enterprise through marketing and communications roles at Kenwood in Britain, then moved into organisational development for the group's human-resources function. She later joined De’ Longhi's board.

In 2016, de’ Longhi became chief corporate services officer, taking responsibility for legal and corporate affairs, human resources and organisation, quality and information technology. The board named her vice-chair in 2025. Her executive career sits within a family-controlled manufacturer whose roots reach an early-twentieth-century industrial workshop and whose modern portfolio spans coffee, food preparation and household appliances.
